newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end mixed, trade subdued ahead of budget.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end mixed, trade subdued ahead of budget.

text.p: London shares had a mixed session in lacklustre trade on Thursday with activity capped ahead of next Tuesday's British budget and sentiment weighed by worries over interest rates and sterling.
"People are sitting on their hands, we've decoupled from Wall Street," said one senior trader. "They've laid out their stalls and battened down their hatches until after the budget."

The FTSE 100 index closed 9.0 points lower at 3,953.8 with losers outweighing gainers by roughly five-to-four. Leading stocks were pinned to a tight trading range as activity waned ahead of the budget. Volume was a modest 585 million shares.
